name: SkiLiftTowerGD20Q
spec: towers-v2 + skeptic; Revision 1b GD (tram_tower.GD / lattice-towers D2 contract)
head: rebuild

derived_from.mode: traced proportions (the DQ rebuild head kit, stretched to the 6.0 m gauge)

wheels.generation: v2 (T62 round 3: cs2_sheaves.wheel, 16 segments, groove, seen hub bosses)

lod.1: flat band on the crest rings + 2 n-gon discs (no boss)

prefab_notes.leg_size_y: StandingObject.m_LegSize.y = leg zone above the origin (ObjectInitializeSystem.cs:1293); pick it on purpose (FG/ET use the mast height)

rope_on_crown.rule: lane on the sheave crown (T27): support lane = axle + seat, compression lane = axle - seat
rope_on_crown.rope: vanilla LV cable mesh hexagon r 0.06 / h 0.052 (round 4; was HV r 0.100 / h 0.0866)

skin.rule: lift alignment phase 2 round 2 (articulation design note, option C): skinned to Root / TrainFront / TrainBack; our code pitches TrainFront by the rope leaving toward game +z and TrainBack by the rope toward -z, about each bone's local X (+ lowers the game +z end), each clamped to theta_max, the half-break |front - back| / 2 to 20 deg

axis.game_plus_z: net -Y = authoring +X (TrainFront = the halves built at authoring +X: rocker_main_<side>_f, yoke_<side>_f)
chain: cs2_asset.orient_for_net (cs2_asset.py:40): (x, y, z) -> (y, -x, z), authoring +X -> net -Y
cs2_asset.export_fbx_skinned (cs2_asset.py:1484-1487): -90 deg about X baked, (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y) x 100 cm: net -Y -> file +z
the game negates FBX x on import (docs/PIPELINE.md frame rule T): game = (-x_net, z_net, -y_net)
tests: skin_part_bones: the _f plates ride TrainFront by travel side (build time)
cs2_skin.roundtrip: every exported level's TrainFront group bbox center at raw z > 0, TrainBack < 0

skin.mesh_changes: cs2_sheaves.dq_train_halves at 10 sheaves a side: per lane two halves (a 4-wheel bogie on a main rocker + a 2-wheel bogie on a link at 12, + a 1-wheel sub on a link at 10; one 4-wheel bogie at 8) on the yoke halves, every sheave 0.09 m further out; the gantry posts land on the girder ends (inboard of the yoke and the rope); the hanger cut short of the yoke; a main pin from inside the girder end through hanger and yoke
surgery: after EVERY import, every LOD prefab: the root bone (parentId -1) m_Rotation (0, 0, 0, 1) and m_Scale (1, 1, 1) (the import gives it -90 deg X / scale 100; gate BONEROOT)

TrainFront / TrainBack: m_Type 0 (None); our code writes each Bone m_Rotation = rest x pitch about local X and sets Skeleton.m_CurrentUpdated (PIPELINE 'Skinned (procedural-bone) assets'); bone names map through ProceduralBone.m_BindIndex (the engine re-sorts bones by hierarchy depth)
LOD0 / LOD1 / LOD2 FBXs are all skinned (SetupLODs copies LOD0's ProceduralAnimationProperties to every LOD); settings.json useProceduralAnimation
rope-lane anchors at the crown lane (+-3.0, 18.284, 0) (T27, phase 1)

prefab.copy_from: SkiLiftTowerDQ16 (tubular sibling) with the GD stubs of SkiGondolaLattice25

net_subobjects.note: spec y = the GD12 bounds top 12.000 (tram_tower.GD tubular_tops[0])
